A web app for playtesting decks for the trading card game *Sorcery: Contested Realm*. You can import a deck list and check it against your Curiosa collection export to see which cards you own. Cards can be sorted into print buckets, and the app generates print-ready PDF proxy sheets and exports deck lists as text.

The project was also an experiment in building an app almost entirely through AI-assisted coding ("vibe coding"): a Flask API with ReportLab/fpdf2 for PDF generation, a React + TypeScript + Tailwind front end, and Vercel for deployment. It taught me a lot about where that workflow speeds things up and where it quietly piles up debt.

**Status:** no longer maintained. This is a fan-made project, not affiliated with Erik's Curiosa.
